name: Comic Strips
original_description:
Tell ChatGPT the story panel by panel, the characters and the dialogue and get an original comic strip with speech bubbles: 3 panels in a row, 4 in a grid or 6 in three rows.

The plugin prepares a draft with the panels, the style and the image model. When you confirm, Abracadabrax renders the strip and ChatGPT returns the link to the image.

For webcomic creators, teachers and anyone with a funny story to tell.

Limitations: original strips from text only. It does not use copyrighted characters or real people, and it does not edit uploaded comics. Producing needs a signed-in Abracadabrax account. If you are not signed in, the plugin gives a link where the same draft opens on Abracadabrax. Outputs are AI-generated.
description_scope: ChatGPT詳細画面の提供元の英語説明。
